title: %interpolate - linear interpolation between two points
purpose: Estimate y at x along the line through (x1, y1) and (x2, y2).
notes: x = 5 is halfway between x1 = 0 and x2 = 10, so y is halfway between 100 and 200.
Argument order is x, x1, y1, x2, y2; when x2 equals x1 the result is y1.

avoid.why: %interpolate requires all five arguments; fewer raises a verb-arity error
